title: HBSE 12th Result 2026 Declared - 84.67% Pass, Deepika Tops with 499/500, Check at bseh.org.in
author: Ash K.
summary: Haryana Board HBSE Class 12 Result 2026 declared on May 12. Overall pass percentage 84.67%. Girls outperformed boys (87.97% vs 81.45%). Deepika from Rewari topped with 499/500. 2,42,856 students appeared. Check at bseh.org.in, DigiLocker, UMANG app.
body: The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has declared the HBSE Class 12 Result 2026. The result was announced on May 12, 2026 by Board Chairman Dr Pawan Kumar at a press conference in Bhiwani.

DetailInformation
Result DeclaredMay 12, 2026
Total Students Appeared2,42,856
Students Passed2,05,618
Overall Pass %84.67%
Girls Pass %87.97%
Boys Pass %81.45%
TopperDeepika (Rewari) - 499/500
2nd RankUdita - 498/500
3rd RankYogita & Muskan - 497/500 each
Self-Study Pass %69.57%
Exam Centres1,431 across Haryana
Check Result Atbseh.org.in / DigiLocker / UMANG

How to check your result: Visit bseh.org.in → Click 'Result Live - Sr. Secondary Examination 2026' → Enter roll number → Submit → View and download marksheet. Also available on DigiLocker (search BSEH, enter roll number + DOB) and UMANG app.
Via SMS: Type your roll number and send to 56263. Result will be delivered via SMS within a few minutes. No internet needed.

Re-evaluation window: BSEH has opened a 20-day window from the result declaration date for re-evaluation and re-checking applications. Apply online through the official portal with the prescribed fee. Rechecking checks for totalling errors. Re-evaluation involves fresh marking of answer sheets.

What's next: Start college admissions immediately. Science stream students can apply for JEE/NEET counselling. Commerce students can target B.Com/BCA/CA Foundation. Arts students can apply for BA/BBA/Law courses. CUET 2026 and state university admission deadlines are running simultaneously.
For career guidance after 12th, check our SSC CGL guide for government job options or our NDA exam guide for defence career after 12th.

faqs.question: When was HBSE 12th Result 2026 declared?
faqs.answer: HBSE Class 12 Result 2026 was declared on May 12, 2026 at 4:00 PM by Board Chairman Dr Pawan Kumar at Bhiwani headquarters.

faqs.question: What is the HBSE 12th pass percentage 2026?
faqs.answer: The overall pass percentage for regular candidates is 84.67%. Girls passed at 87.97% and boys at 81.45%.

faqs.question: Who topped HBSE 12th 2026?
faqs.answer: Deepika from Rewari secured the state top rank with 499 marks out of 500. Udita came second with 498 marks.

faqs.question: How to check HBSE 12th Result 2026?
faqs.answer: Visit bseh.org.in and enter your roll number. Also available on DigiLocker, UMANG app, and via SMS to 56263.

faqs.question: Can I apply for re-evaluation of HBSE 12th result?
faqs.answer: Yes. BSEH has opened a 20-day window from result declaration for re-evaluation and re-checking applications through the official portal.

faqs.question: How many students appeared for HBSE 12th 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 2,42,856 students appeared, out of which 2,05,618 passed and 10,498 failed.
